meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会打开浏览器执行网页操作:访问网址、点击元素、填写表单、读取页面内容,也能截图、生成 PDF、录制视频以及对比页面前后变化。
howto.when: 当你要浏览网页、填表或截图等操作时触发;也用于测试网页应用和提取页面数据。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截一张全页截图
say.note: 会导航到该网址并生成截图文件

say.text: 帮我登录测试页,填好账号密码再提交
say.note: 会用快照找输入框并自动填写提交

say.text: 把当前页面里所有链接的文字和地址抓出来
say.note: 会读取页面元素并返回链接列表

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can drive a browser: open URLs, click elements, fill forms, read page content, take screenshots, export PDFs, record video, and compare page states.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to browse websites, fill forms, take screenshots, test web apps, or extract data from pages.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a full-page screenshot.
say_en.note: Navigates to the URL and saves a screenshot file.

say_en.text: Log into the test page, fill in credentials, and submit.
say_en.note: Finds inputs via snapshot and submits the form.

say_en.text: Extract all link texts and URLs from this page.
say_en.note: Reads page elements and returns the links.
